
# 样本基本信息


```{r spl-msg}
data_group <- read.xlsx(head_path, sheet = 2)

if(sum(colnames(data_group) == '样本分组') > 1) {
  sum_spl <- sum(data_group[,colnames(data_group) == '样本数量'], na.rm = T)
  rel_spl <- sum(data_group[,colnames(data_group) == '实验检测'], na.rm = T)
} else {
  sum_spl <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(data_group[data_group$组别 == '样本数量', -1])), na.rm = T)
  rel_spl <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(data_group[data_group$组别 == '实验检测', -1])), na.rm = T)
} 

str <- glue::glue(
  "共收到客户提供的{sum_spl}例{spl_name}样本，实际检测{rel_spl}例{spl_name}样本。",
  sum_spl=sum_spl,
  spl_name=l.a$spl_name,
  rel_spl=rel_spl
  )

pander(str)
```

```{r spl-tab, results = "asis"}
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(purrr)

max_cols <- 8           # 这里指“数值列”数量；总列数 = 1(组别) + max_cols
id_col   <- data_group[, 1, drop = FALSE]
value_cols <- data_group[, -1, drop = FALSE]
n_val <- ncol(value_cols)

seq(1, n_val, by = max_cols) %>%
  walk2(seq_along(.), function(start_idx, idx) {
    end_idx <- min(start_idx + max_cols - 1, n_val)
    chunk <- cbind(id_col, value_cols[, start_idx:end_idx, drop = FALSE])

    caption_text <- if (idx == 1) "样本信息表" else NULL

    chunk %>%
      kbl("latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = caption_text) %>%
      kable_styling(latex_options = "striped") %>%
      column_spec(1, width = "5em") %>%
      print()
  })
```

*注：①样本收到后，立即保存在-80℃低温冰箱中，直至实验检测；②为了更好地进行实验，对样本进行了重新编号，详细见“Table S0-样本编号对应表”（若未重新编号则无该表）。*

### 代谢物提取

```{r extract}
## extract method based on sample type
extract <- read.xlsx(head_path, sheet = grep(l.a$spl_type, excel_sheets(head_path))) %>% tibble()
if(!l.a$has_qc) extract <- extract[1:(nrow(extract)-1), ]

extract %>%
  kbl("latex", booktabs = TRUE, caption = "样品前处理步骤") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options="striped") %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "15cm")
```
